intro: We specify systems against Portuguese wind, salt, and programme — not generic European stock photos.

items.title: Façade envelope, Parque das Nações
items.summary: 24-storey residential envelope with class 6 decks, mesh, and a travelling weather roof so render continued through November rain.

items.title: Tank farm access, Port of Sines
items.summary: Circular birdcages around four crude tanks. Salt-rated HDG fleet, ATEX-aware decking, 24-hour hire desk during shutdown.

items.title: Cloister restoration, Belém
items.summary: Independent scaffold standing off historic masonry. No drill-in ties to Manueline stone; kentledge and needle beams only.

items.title: Live-hall plant deck, Taguspark
items.summary: Temporary steel over a live data hall. 150 kN towers, crash deck, and a 48-hour reverse-out clause in the hire contract.

items.title: Ward block extension, Loures
items.summary: Three-storey site offices with EI 60 links, plus façade frames on the new ward. Welfare sized to ACT inspection from week one.

items.title: Nacelle access, Serra do Alvão
items.summary: Mountain wind zone III. Modular towers with ballast tables issued per turbine, updated daily from site anemometer.
